import sys
import pandas as pd

path = "budget.xlsx"

try:
    sheets = pd.read_excel(path, sheet_name=None, header=None)
except Exception as e:
    print("ERROR reading file:", e)
    sys.exit(1)

print("SHEETS:", list(sheets.keys()))
for name, df in sheets.items():
    print(f"\n=== Sheet: {name} (shape {df.shape}) ===")
    print(df.to_string())

import pandas as pd

try:
    sheets = pd.read_excel(path, sheet_name=None, header=None)
except Exception as e:
    print("ERROR reading file:", e)
    sys.exit(1)

print("SHEETS:", list(sheets.keys()))
for name, df in sheets.items():

import sys
from openpyxl import load_workbook

path = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "budget.xlsx"

wb = load_workbook(path, data_only=False)
ws = wb["Budget"]
print("dims:", ws.dimensions)
print("max_row:", ws.max_row, "max_col:", ws.max_column)

# Show every non-empty cell in columns A-C rows 1..25: raw value and formula
for row in range(1, 26):
    for col in range(1, 4):
        cell = ws.cell(row=row, column=col)
        if cell.value is not None:
            print(f"{cell.coordinate!r}: type={cell.data_type} value={cell.value!r}")

wb2 = load_workbook(path, data_only=True)
ws2 = wb2["Budget"]
print("\n--- Cached computed values (data_only) rows 20-25 ---")
for row in range(20, 26):
    for col in range(1, 4):
        cell = ws2.cell(row=row, column=col)
        print(f"{cell.coordinate!r}: {cell.value!r}")

import sys
from openpyxl import load_workbook

path = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 'budget.xlsx'
wb = load_workbook(path, data_only=True, read_only=True)
grand = 0.0

for ws in wb.worksheets:
    it = ws.iter_rows(values_only=True)
    try:
        header = [str(h).strip().lower() if h is not None else '' for h in next(it)]
    except StopIteration:
        continue
    col_idx = range(len(header))
    amt_cols = [i for i in col_idx if any(k in header[i] for k in ('amount', 'expense', 'cost', 'total', 'spent'))]
    cat_cols = [i for i in col_idx if 'categor' in header[i] or 'item' in header[i] or 'name' in header[i]]
    sheet_total = 0.0
    for row in it:
        label = ''
        if cat_cols:
            v = row[cat_cols[0]]
            label = str(v).strip().lower() if v is not None else ''
        skip = label in ('total', 'grand total', 'sum') or not amt_cols
        if skip:
            continue
        for i in amt_cols:
            v = row[i]
            if isinstance(v, (int, float)) and not isinstance(v, bool):
                sheet_total += float(v)
    grand += sheet_total
    print(f"{ws.title} sheet total: {sheet_total}")

print(f"GRAND TOTAL EXPENSES: {grand}")

import sys
from collections import OrderedDict
from openpyxl import load_workbook

path = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 'budget.xlsx'
wb = load_workbook(path, data_only=True, read_only=True)
ws = wb.worksheets[0]

rows = list(ws.iter_rows(values_only=True))
start = next(i for i, r in enumerate(rows) if r and str(r[0]).strip().upper() == 'EXPENSES')
end = next(i for i in range(start + 1, len(rows))
           if rows[i] and str(rows[i][0]).strip().lower().startswith('total'))

cats = OrderedDict()
for r in rows[start + 1:end]:
    label = r[0].strip() if r[0] else None
    nums = [v for v in r[1:] if isinstance(v, (int, float)) and not isinstance(v, bool)]
    if label and nums:
        cats[label] = cats.get(label, 0.0) + float(nums[0])

grand = 0.0
for name, val in cats.items():
    print(f"{name}: {val:g}")
    grand += val
print(f"TOTAL EXPENSES: {grand:g}")
